data.investment_objective:
The objective of the Scheme is to invest in companies whose securities are included in Nifty200 Momentum 30 Index 
and subject to tracking errors, to endeavour to achieve the returns of the above index as closely as possible. This 
would be done by investing in all the stocks comprising the Nifty200 Momentum 30 Index in the same weightage that 
they represent in Nifty200 Momentum 30 Index. 
However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme shall be achieved.
